We need to determine number of C=O groups in the compound. But we have no structure given. Possibly we need to retrieve IR spectra to see carbonyl stretch? Or carbon NMR? But we need number of carbonyls. Could also be deduced from IR: carbonyl stretch around 1700 cm-1. But need count. Could use IR spectra tool; it returns a string with peaks. We can count number of carbonyl peaks? Usually one carbonyl gives one strong peak. If multiple carbonyls, may have multiple peaks. Could also use carbon NMR: carbonyl carbons appear around 190-210 ppm. Counting those peaks.

We need to decide which tool minimal cost. IR is cheap. Use ir_spectra.
